title: Queue-row draw predicate lacks the amber_pct>0 guard the measure pass gained — row counts diverge at amber==0
evidence: noc_queue_rows (measure): `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] > 0 || (amber_pct > 0 && p.util_pct >= u32(amber_pct)) {` — draw_noc_panel (draw): `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] == 0 && p.util_pct < u32(amber_pct) { continue }` — and the standing contract: `// MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row (same count predicates + the SAME visible-row caps).` The new test pins 0 as meaningful: `testing.expect_value(t, noc_queue_rows(&sr, 0), i32(1))  // amber 0 = only the queued pipe`
detail: At amber_pct==0 the draw's `util_pct < u32(0)` is never true, so every pipe draws a queue row while the measure counts only queued pipes; the scroll clamp's total undercounts rows actually drawn. Unreachable today (catalog.odin validates pipe_amber_pct >= 1 fail-fast), but the diff canonizes 0 = disabled in the measure + test only.
recommended_fix: Add the symmetric guard to the draw predicate: `if p.q[0]+p.q[1]+p.q[2] == 0 && (amber_pct <= 0 || p.util_pct < u32(amber_pct)) { continue }` so measure and draw agree at amber==0.

title: tx ring's 0 = never-written sentinel collides with tick 0 — served work recorded at tick 0 is permanently invisible to the window
evidence: `tx_slot_tick: [dynamic]u64, // per-slot last-write tick (0 = never written)` — record: `if b.tx_slot_tick[s] != tick {` (at tick 0: `0 != 0` is false, so no stale reset; `b.tx_served[s] += served` accumulates into a slot whose key stays 0) — window: `lo := u64(0)` ... `if st > lo && st <= tick {` (`st == 0` never satisfies `st > 0`). step() permits tick 0: `if tick < state.tick {` passes with state.tick init 0 (same-tick re-steps are 'deliberately allowed' per the step.odin comment).
detail: A legal step at tick 0 records served units the window reader can never see (st=0 reads as empty until slot reuse at tick W overwrites); a re-step at 0 accumulates invisibly. Latent — app/harness all pre-increment so tick 0 is never stepped today — but the new ring has no tick>0 guard.
recommended_fix: Store the tick key biased (tick+1) or use a max-value sentinel for empty, so a tick-0 write is distinguishable from never-written; or assert tick > 0 in bundle_tx_record.
